summary: Bind compatibility policy storage and file-tool self-protection to one canonical filesystem identity, including explicitly selected root aliases and existing Windows short filenames.
decisions: Only startup-selected root aliases may be translated through the trusted RootPolicy; no arbitrary symlink expansion is introduced.

Check every remaining existing storage parent before canonicalizing it, preserving nested and unselected symlink rejection. Missing parents are neither created nor trusted until normal write-time validation.

Canonicalize an existing regular-file leaf as well as its parents, so Windows 8.3 aliases cannot evade policy and sidecar exclusion. Refuse linked, multiply linked, redirected or changed storage identities.
Retargeting an explicitly selected root alias after startup cannot redirect the stored policy path.
Support macOS native temporary-directory aliases only through explicit startup-root selection, while retaining the ordinary parent checks elsewhere.
Limit this worker's change to the assigned source, test and provenance files; the integration owner performs aggregate formatting, roadmap review/render and platform qualification.

tests.command: Compare pre-fix path.resolve storage binding with real RootPolicy canonical request identity for an explicitly selected alias
tests.result: RED identity assertion reproduced: the two paths differ, so the old equivalent-path exclusion cannot match. This is a focused identity proof, not a full pre-fix configuration exploit on Linux, whose old parent guard rejects symlink aliases.

tests.command: Native Node24 TypeScript transform of the exact production helper; exercise it with real RootPolicy and temporary filesystem fixtures
tests.result: GREEN 10 filesystem assertions: selected alias, matching guard identity, nested and unselected parent denial, fixed identity after retarget, no external state, existing regular-file identity, symbolic-link denial, hardlink denial and unchanged bytes.

tests.result: PASS syntax checks. Native transformation is not pinned TypeScript typechecking.

tests.result: Pending the integration owner's locked dependency runner. Scratch lacks pinned zod and cannot run the full configuration suite. Windows alias test reports a skip if 8.3 filenames are disabled.

roadmap_updates.assessment: No stages, weights or acceptance counts change. This is a security correction to recovered, incompletely qualified source. The integration owner must review/render the combined source fingerprint after cherry-picking.

limitations: Full pinned TypeScript, formatter, CompatibilityConfig/MCP suites and Windows/macOS tests remain pending; no remote tool or original workstation checkout was touched by this follow-up.
Startup identity checks do not create an operating-system sandbox or promise immunity to hostile concurrent filesystem mutation.
